item.tib: stag la phur bu rtse med kyi rgyud las dbang chog
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis/ phung bon g+ho mar (mgo dmar) la brgyud cing*/ dar nub res shig byung kyang (yang /)ma 'ongs kho bo dbra rigs g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis/ gyim shod nub phyogs zhol du bgyis so/ bkra shis dpal 'bar bon bstan dar rgyas shog
